ayahs.2: Kya hai woh khadkhada dene wali.
ayahs.3: Tujhe kya maloom ke woh khadkhada dene wali kya hai.
ayahs.4: Jis din insaan bikhre hue parwaanon ki tarah ho jaaenge.
ayahs.5: Aur pahaad dhune hue rangeen oon ki tarah ho jaaenge.
ayahs.6: Phir jis ke palde bhaari honge.
ayahs.7: Woh to dil-pasand aaraam ki zindagi mein hoga.
ayahs.8: Aur jis ke palde halke honge.
ayahs.10: Tujhe kya maloom ke woh kya hai.
